summary: The AllowedList functionality is part of the HSPnet framework, designed to manage and verify allowed locations within sessions. It offers methods to retrieve allowed locations and check if a particular location is within the allowed list using session parameters.
purpose: The purpose of AllowedList is to define and verify access to certain locations based on session parameters within the framework, ensuring that only designated locations are permissible.

entities.name: AllowedList
entities.description: Represents a location code that is allowed within a session.

entities.name: HSPnetSession
entities.description: Session object containing database connection and session ID.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: The code representing an allowed location.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Acts on the database to retrieve allowed locations.

workflows.name: Retrieve Allowed Locations
steps: Initialize the session and set procedure name to 'SessionAllowedLocations'.
Add parameters 'LocType' and 'SessionID' to the session database call.
Execute database procedure and retrieve data using a SqlDataReader.
Iterate through the data reader, creating AllowedList objects for each record.
Add an AllowedList entry with a code if a matching ID is found or if it equals '-1'.
Close the data reader and return the list of allowed entries.

workflows.name: Check Allowed List
steps: Iterate through the list of AllowedList entries.
Check if the current entry's code equals 'ALL' or matches the provided ID.
Return true if a match is found, otherwise continue checking.
Return false if no matches are found after the iteration.

business_rules: Location codes are checked against the allowed list.
A code of 'ALL' signifies universal access to all locations.
validations: Ensure IDs are valid integers before casting to strings for comparison.
conditions: Check if the data reader object is not null before processing.
Validate if the code equals 'ALL' or matches the ID for access approval.
system_behavior: Retrieves data and processes it to form allowed location list.
dependencies: Relies on a valid HSPnetSession to access database and run procedures.
exceptions: Break the loop and return if 'ALL' code is encountered in the list.
